title: Paracelsus: Historisch-kritische Ausgabe
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: Historical-critical edition of Arthur Schnitzler’s one-act verse drama „Paracelsus“ (written 1894–1898). This edition presents a detailed preface, documenting both the genesis of the text as well as the printing history, a transcription of the genetic materials with facsimiles, a print text with a display of textual variants and a commentary.
